verdict.rationale: Slack's official slackapi/slack-api-specs repository publishes a downloadable OpenAPI spec for the Web API (web-api/slack_web_openapi_v2.json) and AsyncAPI specs for the Events API, which directly delivers a machine-readable API spec. The probe's 404s only show the spec is not hosted at common docs.slack.dev paths; they do not contradict the GitHub-hosted spec. Missing for 10: the spec is the older OpenAPI 2.0 format with no evidence of a current 3.x version, it is not discoverable at standard well-known URLs on the docs site, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of its completeness or currency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
